title: docs: add hands-on RAG workshop and multi-tool agent cookbook
author: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Adds a developer-focused, hands-on RAG workshop page and a companion 'multi-tool agent cookbook' with TypeScript and Python agent examples, expanded tool-calling patterns, and a reproducible local playground using Docker and the redwood-examples templates. Motivation: internal feedback and community requests show users want step-by-step interactive lessons that combine retrieval, structured tool calls (search, db, code-exec), and simple eval harnesses for prompt regressions. This PR bundles authored workshop content, runnable example code, and docs site components so new users can run a mini-workshop locally or follow the guide on the docs site. Changes: - docs/workshops/rag-workshop.md: new workshop guide with sections for architecture, learning objectives, pre-reqs, exercise walkthroughs, and suggested evaluation checkpoints. - docs/cookbooks/agent-multi-tool-cookbook.md: patterns for combining retrieval, tool-calling, and function-style structured outputs with safety notes. - examples/workshop-playground/docker-compose.yml: lightweight local playground that launches a vector DB (sqlite+qdrant-adapter), a sample retrieval index builder, and a toy tool service. - examples/workshop-playground/agents/ts-agent-sample.ts: TypeScript agent example using the redwood SDK with two tool adapters (search, code-runner) and explicit fallback policies. - examples/workshop-playground/agents/py-agent-sample.py: Python mirror of the TS agent, focusing on function-style outputs for downstream parsing. - assets/workshop/diagrams/rag-flow.svg and assets/workshop/prompts.yaml: visual and prompt assets used by the exercises. - docs/_sidebar.yml: add workshop and cookbook to docs navigation. - docs/playground-setup.md: step-by-step local setup and troubleshooting. Testing & validation: - Local smoke: followed workshop steps locally, validated example agents against the toy workspace. - CI: docs build + linkcheck + example linting. - Manual evals: small regression prompts run to ensure structured outputs stable across SDK versions. Checklist: - [x] Workshop guide drafts and images included - [x] Runnable examples added and tested locally - [x] Docs navigation updated - [x] CI checks added for examples linting - [x] Linear ticket ENG-3241 referenced in PR body Breaking changes: none; this is docs/examples only. UX notes: examples use conservative default config (small local models, SQLite-backed vector store) so the workshop runs on developer laptops. Attribution: inspired by community forum threads and a customer workshop request (SUP-558).
commits: 3 commits: 1) add workshop guide and assets (asha) 2) add playground examples and agent samples (asha) 3) update docs nav and CI to include new examples (asha)
